description: List positive expected value (+EV) prices: a bookmaker price longer than the outcome's fair price, with the EV in percent of the stake, the fair price, how it was made (a sharp bookmaker's own market such as Pinnacle's with its margin removed, an exchange, or a consensus of other bookmakers) and the full-Kelly stake. Australian bookmakers only by default; set region to all for every bookmaker. Upcoming events only. Needs a Pro key or the free 7-day Pro trial. Costs 10 credits for each page of up to 100 entries it reads (at most 3 pages); the bookmaker list it reads first is free.

fair_method.description: Only fair prices made this way: sharp_book (a sharp bookmaker's own market), exchange, or consensus

league_id.description: Only this league, for example nba, nfl, afl or nrl. Leave it out for every league.

markets.description: Optional comma separated market keys, at most 20, for example winner,handicap or player_points_over_under

min_ev_pct.description: Only prices with at least this expected value, in percent of the stake, for example 2

region.description: Keep entries whose every price is at a bookmaker in this region. Default au (Australian bookmakers). Use all for every bookmaker.

name: find_ev
title: Find positive EV prices
